2026_12_NE_LAC.summary: Drake Maye's fractured ankle: the market has Tommy DeVito starting, and our ratings still rate New England with Maye.

reasons.text: QB Drake Maye fractured his right ankle in the Week 10 loss in Munich and could miss the rest of the season; Tommy DeVito is expected to start.
New England comes off two straight blowout losses (Lions, Packers) and a bye; the game was moved to 4:05 PM ET Nov 29.

swings.LAC: QB Drake Maye fractured his ankle in Munich and Tommy DeVito is expected to start for New England, so the market moved to the Chargers; our ratings didn't (theScore, Nov 17).
swings.NE: Drake Maye's fractured ankle (Week 10) put Tommy DeVito at QB; the market marked New England down, our ratings still carry Maye (theScore, Nov 17).

swings.MIN: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is ruled out and Kirk Cousins starts; the market dropped Minnesota, our ratings didn't (ESPN, Nov 20).

2026_11_MIN_SF.summary: Kyler Murray is out and Kirk Cousins starts, with WR Jordan Addison also out; that covers most of our 2-point gap.

reasons.text: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is ruled out; Kirk Cousins starts at San Francisco.
WR Jordan Addison is out after thumb surgery.
Partly offsetting: TE T.J. Hockenson and LB Blake Cashman are back for Minnesota; 49ers WR Mike Evans (Achilles) is set to play.

returning.text: TE (wrist) has no injury designation for San Francisco.

2026_11_NO_CHI.summary: New Orleans is without three offensive line starters, LB Pete Werner, CB Martin Emerson Jr. and released S Justin Reid; that covers most of the 3-point gap.

reasons.text: Saints OT Taliese Fuaga, C Erik McCoy and OT Asim Richards are inactive: three line starters.
LB Pete Werner and CB Martin Emerson Jr. are also inactive, and starting S Justin Reid was released at his request.
Pushing the other way: Bears CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) is inactive.

2026_12_CHI_DET.summary: Aidan Hutchinson's season-ending ACL tear moved this line from Detroit -2.5 (spring) to Chicago -2.5; that's worth about 2 of our 4-point gap.

reasons.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson (torn ACL) is on IR for the season; C Cade Mays (ankle) went on IR Saturday, so he misses at least four games.
The early (May) line had Detroit -2.5, so the market has swung about 5 points since then.
Bears CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) sat Week 11 and could miss this game too, which pushes the market's way less than Hutchinson's loss.

swings.DET: DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL and C Cade Mays went on IR; the market marked Detroit down, our ratings haven't caught up (ESPN, Nov 22).

2026_12_NYG_IND.summary: The Colts cut QB Daniel Jones after a 26-3 loss at Houston and turn to Anthony Richardson, with both tackles and both top corners hurt; our ratings see none of it.

reasons.text: Indianapolis released starting QB Daniel Jones Friday; Shane Steichen named Anthony Richardson the starter, with Riley Leonard as backup.
In Thursday's 26-3 loss at Houston the Colts played without OTs Bernhard Raimann and Jalen Travis and CBs Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward.
The line opened Giants -4.5 and is now -6.5, after the Jones release.

swings.NYG: Nothing Giants-specific (clean injury report); the market moved on Indianapolis' 26-3 loss and the Daniel Jones release (ESPN, Nov 20).

2026_12_NYJ_MIA.summary: Miami is on Kyle McCord with Malik Willis on IR, and Geno Smith is cleared for the Jets; that explains part of the gap, but some books still have Miami favored.

reasons.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord started the Week 10 loss.
Jets QB Geno Smith (ankle) has no injury designation this week after clean scans.
Books disagree: StatSniper shows DraftKings at Miami -1.5, against the Jets -3 we use.

swings.DAL: CB DaRon Bland went on IR, and S Jalen Thompson, G Tyler Booker and TE Jake Ferguson (knee, likely multiple weeks) were out in Week 11; the market marked Dallas down (NBC Sports, Nov 22).

2026_11_TB_DET.summary: Detroit lost DE Aidan Hutchinson for the season and has CBs D.J. Reed and Ennis Rakestraw Jr. inactive, covering part of the 3-point gap; Baker Mayfield is active for Tampa Bay.

reasons.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson (torn ACL) is on IR for the season; C Cade Mays (ankle) went on IR Saturday.
CBs D.J. Reed (hip) and Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (shoulder) are inactive; pushing the other way, S Kerby Joseph is active for the first time this season.
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield (foot/thumb) is active and starts; S Antoine Winfield Jr. is inactive.

returning.text: S is active for the first time this season.

swings.DET: DE Aidan Hutchinson's season-ending ACL tear (placed on IR Nov 18) and C Cade Mays going to IR moved the market off Detroit; our ratings still carry Hutchinson (ESPN, Nov 22).

2026_12_WAS_ARI.summary: Arizona's QB room is the likely reason: Gardner Minshew is on IR and Carson Beck sat out Week 11 with a back injury, after a 34-6 loss to the Rams.

reasons.text: QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) is on IR after UCL surgery; Carson Beck (back) was ruled out at Kansas City and Josh Johnson started. Beck's next chance is Washington.
Arizona lost 34-6 to the Rams in Week 10 and plays at Kansas City before this game.

swings.GB: Edge Micah Parsons (ACL) is targeting his season debut at the Rams on Nov 25 after practicing since early November; the market moved toward Green Bay, our ratings were built without him (Packers.com, Nov 4).

watch.text: QB Drake Maye fractured his right ankle in Week 10 and may miss the season; Tommy DeVito starts, but our ratings were built with Maye.
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is ruled out again, so Kirk Cousins starts; WR Jordan Addison is out after thumb surgery.
DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL and is out for the season; C Cade Mays went on IR Saturday. Our ratings still include Hutchinson's games.
S Kerby Joseph is active vs. Tampa Bay for the first time this season; our ratings were built entirely without him.
QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) is on IR after UCL surgery and starter Carson Beck (back) was ruled out at Kansas City; Josh Johnson started Week 11.
QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord starts.
Three offensive line starters out: OT Asim Richards (weeks), OT Taliese Fuaga and C Erik McCoy.
Starting S Justin Reid was released at his request; LB Pete Werner and CB Martin Emerson Jr. are also inactive at Chicago.
The Colts released QB Daniel Jones after the 26-3 loss at Houston; Anthony Richardson starts. Both starting tackles and both top corners missed that game.
QB Baker Mayfield (foot/right thumb) is active and starts at Detroit after a questionable tag; S Antoine Winfield Jr. is inactive.
QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery) is on IR with a Week 16 target; Jacoby Brissett starts. CB Marlon Humphrey is deactivated this week.
Jalen Hurts is on IR for the season; Joe Milton makes his second start. Philadelphia has lost seven straight.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), out five of the last six games, will play vs. the Steelers per the final injury report.
LB Zack Baun (back), a 93% snap starter, and WR Dontayvion Wicks were placed on IR Saturday.
G Trey Smith, OT Jaylon Moore and RB Kenneth Walker III are all out vs. Arizona.
CB DaRon Bland (IR Saturday), G Tyler Booker (high-ankle sprain) and S Jalen Thompson are all out; Bland and Booker were full-time starters.
TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) is inactive vs. Tennessee and likely out multiple weeks, per Brian Schottenheimer.
Rookie Fernando Mendoza took over at QB after Kirk Cousins was traded to Minnesota; most of the ratings were built with Cousins.
Edge Micah Parsons, out since last December's ACL tear, returned to practice Nov 4 and is targeting a Nov 25 debut at the Rams, per Ian Rapoport; our ratings were built without him.
QB Geno Smith (ankle) is cleared to start at the Chargers after Cade Klubnik played much of the Week 10 loss to Buffalo.
WR Mike Evans (Achilles) left Week 6 early and has missed the games since; he is expected back vs. Minnesota, so recent results came without him.
CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) is inactive vs. New Orleans and could also miss Thanksgiving at Detroit.
